Thanks Aditya — quick clarifications from our side after today's internal sync. A few must-haves to lock into the MAP:

1) PHI handling / HIPAA considerations:
- We will be sending PHI in some payloads (patient identifiers / clinical notes).
- Requirement: Redwood must support a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) and demonstrate technical controls for PHI.
- No PHI should be persisted in any shared logs or telemetry accessible outside our dedicated tenancy.

2) Retention & logging:
- Retention: default 90 days for inference payloads; options to reduce to 30 days. No indefinite retention.
- Audit trail: must be able to produce per-request audit logs (who, when, which model, request id) for 1 year on request (can be archived).
- Redaction: ability to redact or exclude specific fields from training/analytics and from any debug logs.

3) Encryption & keys:
- Customer-managed keys (KMS) preferred for data-at-rest encryption.
- TLS for in-flight; HSM or cloud KMS integration for keys.

4) Isolation:
- Preferred: dedicated instance / tenancy for PHI workloads. If not available, clear mitigation (firm tenant isolation + RBAC + network controls).

I'm attaching our security questionnaire (completed sections inline) — see attached HealthTech_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx.

If Redwood can confirm the above items and provide an updated MAP with explicit owners and dates, we'll move this to procurement/legal and aim to have a final decision by mid-December.

Thanks,

Hi Sarah — copying a short technical commitment / clarification from Redwood so we can put this into the MAP draft. High level: we can meet the items you listed; a few notes below on implementation, owners, and realistic timelines.

Redwood commitments (technical):
- BAA/DPA: Redwood legal will provide a draft BAA/DPA within 3 business days of a signed NDA/engagement. Owner: Legal (Redwood) / Procurement (HealthTech).
- SOC 2: we'll provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (redacted as needed) by 2026-11-17. Owner: Marissa Cole (Security).
- PHI retention: default inference payload retention = 90 days; configurable to 30 days. Logs are separated from customer payload storage. Owner: Neha Kapoor (Solutions).
- Audit logs: per-request audit logs (request id, timestamp, model, routing) available for 365 days in archived storage; retrieval via support ticket within SLA (48 hours). Owner: Marissa Cole.
- Redaction: we provide field-level redaction configuration and a streaming redact path for PII/PHI fields; note: redaction happens at ingestion edge prior to model invocation if configured. Owner: Neha Kapoor.
- KMS: customer-managed KMS supported for at-rest encryption; initial exchange + test keys required before production. Owner: Infrastructure / Security.
- Isolation: Dedicated tenancy (recommended for PHI) — we can schedule a dedicated instance for HealthTech as part of Dedicated offering; target provisioning lead time 3-4 weeks after order.

Updated MAP items (summary for MAP v2):
- Milestone: Data Handling & Compliance (updated)
  - Target close date: 2026-12-10
  - Redwood deliverables: SOC 2 report (by 2026-11-17), draft BAA/DPA (3 business days after NDA), updated MAP v2 with owners (attached), technical runbook for audit log retrieval, retention config doc.
  - HealthTech deliverables: Confirm retention value (90 or 30 days), share legal contact for DPA review, confirm requirement for dedicated tenancy.
  - Dependencies: Signed SOW, KMS integration test, legal review completion.

I attached an updated MAP (MAP_DataHandling_Draft_v2.pdf) and a short security-response.xlsx that maps our commitments to your questionnaire.
